::: {.bnr-manual-flag .bnr-manual-flag--technical}
Technical Manual
:::

## What this task achieves

Use this route to classify CVD deaths, create an authorised mortality release
and publish its approved results on the Info-Hub.

## Before you start

- Confirm the release year and month and authority to proceed.
- Use the authorised workstation, private workspace and mortality REDCap access.
- Leave replacement controls off unless a rerun has been agreed.

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="Procedure at a glance"}
Authorise → extract and classify deaths → calculate mortality measures → review
and approve → publish the data package → deploy the website.
:::

## Complete the following steps

| Order | Manual | Task | Detailed guidance |
|---:|---|---|---|
| 1 | [Operations]{.bnr-manual-label .bnr-manual-label--operations} | **Authorise one consistent mortality release** — reporting cut-off; authority; access; replacement decision | Follow [Authorise a data export](../../operations/release/data-release.qmd), then check [Before starting the mortality workflow](../../operations/post-redcap/mortality-workflow.qmd#before-starting). |
| 2 | [Technical]{.bnr-manual-label .bnr-manual-label--technical} | **Extract and classify the private death records** — authorised month-end extract; fixed Heart and Stroke classifier; review evidence | Complete [Step 1: Extract mortality data](../workflows/mortality/extract.qmd) and [Step 2: Classify CVD deaths](../workflows/mortality/classify.qmd) with the same release year and month. |
| 3 | [Technical]{.bnr-manual-label .bnr-manual-label--technical} | **Build the private mortality measures** — Primary and Inclusive definitions; counts; percentages; comparisons; rates; automated worklists | Follow [Build mortality burden data](../workflows/mortality/build-burden.qmd). |
| 4 | [Operations]{.bnr-manual-label .bnr-manual-label--operations} [Technical]{.bnr-manual-label .bnr-manual-label--technical} | **Review, protect and approve the exact proposed release** — plausibility; disclosure control; proposed public file; named approval | Complete [Review the mortality release](../workflows/mortality/review.qmd) and [Approve the reviewed release](../workflows/mortality/approve.qmd), using the [Operations workflow](../../operations/post-redcap/mortality-workflow.qmd#step-4-review-the-mortality-release) for the decision points. |
| 5 | [Technical]{.bnr-manual-label .bnr-manual-label--technical} | **Publish the unchanged approved data package** — approval verification; official public copy; website mirror | Follow [Publish mortality outputs](../workflows/mortality/publish.qmd). |
| 6 | [Public Methods]{.bnr-manual-label .bnr-manual-label--methods} | **Check the public meaning of the results** — death classification; Primary and Inclusive definitions; mortality counts and rates | Use [How CVD deaths are classified](../../methods/interpretation/classifying-cvd-deaths.qmd) and [CVD mortality](../../methods/measures/mortality.qmd). |
| 7 | [Technical]{.bnr-manual-label .bnr-manual-label--technical} | **Render and deploy the website** — mortality dashboard; tables; Downloads catalogue; Git review; pull request; live-site check | Follow [Edit and publish website content](edit-publish-website-content.qmd). Dashboards, tables and Downloads refresh from the approved files during the normal render; no separate refresh action is required. |

## How to confirm completion

Step 6 reports successful publication, the website deployment succeeds, and the
live mortality dashboard, tables and Downloads entry use the intended release.
